description: This file contains the PHP class 'Subscription' in the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account', which handles subscription-related actions in the customer account section of OpenCart, including listing subscriptions, viewing details, and managing subscription data.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class managing customer subscriptions, including listing active subscriptions and detailed view of a specific subscription.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the subscription list, including pagination, breadcrumbs, and loading subscription data.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including subscription status, related products, addresses, and historical data.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles the subscription claim history and transaction log, fetching history entries and total count.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the subscription's order history, including comments, status updates, dates, and view links, using request parameters.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Sets the subscription order page view.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed order information for a specific subscription, including associated products, prices, status, and pagination for related orders.
